title: model.request payload
description: Model request v4 observation: byte counts, selected tools and call lifecycle identity. No prompt content or content digest is published.

selected_tools.description: Tool names bound for this model call (v4: actual bound tools).

context_view.description: Immutable ContextHost View identity selected for this request; content is not embedded.

call_id.description: Opaque per-invocation identity shared by this call's model.usage samples and model.call.finished closure (v4).

mode.description: Invocation mode observed at the model boundary (v4).

provider.description: Provider identity resolved for this call (v4).

model.description: Model identity resolved for this call (v4).

source.description: Route attribution: main, child, compaction summary, or paid maintenance call (v4).
